versions.content: If the reception deadline monitoring timer of a signal or signal group expires and the configuration parameter ComRxDataTimeoutAction for this signal or signal group is either omitted or configured to NONE, the AUTOSAR COM module shall not replace the signal or the signals of the signal groups respectively.
